result.note: Tests the August 2026 India–Uzbekistan upgrade: partnership status, uranium arrangement and trade target.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the India–Uzbekistan engagement of August 2026:
items: The two countries elevated their ties to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership.
The two sides advanced an arrangement for the supply of uranium.
The two sides set a bilateral trade target of USD 10 billion for 2030.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 3 is wrong because the trade target set for 2030 is USD 5 billion, not USD 10 billion. On 31 August 2026 the two countries also advanced a uranium supply arrangement and raised ties to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership.
questions.source: India and Uzbekistan set a USD 5 billion trade target for 2030 and advanced a uranium supply arrangement, elevating ties to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership.
